fields.label: Key
fields.description: A short name in lower case with underscores, for example numerology. Guides name their skills by it.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Which of the site's guides does this skill: pandit_ji, numerologist, dream_guide or tarot. Its rules and tools are the area's. Blank while no guide can do it yet.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Switch on only when the area's guide has the knowledge and the tools for it. A guide whose skill is off is not shown.

fields.label: Knowledge it reads
fields.description: The shelves of the Academy knowledge a guide with this skill searches, separated by commas, for example numerology, consult. A guide never reads beyond its area's own shelves, and with several skills it reads the shelves of all of them.

fields.label: What it needs
fields.description: What must be in place before this skill is switched on.
